news.headline: United Wholesale Mortgage plunges 35% after suspending dividend and raising capital
news.summary: United Wholesale Mortgage is suspending its dividend and raising capital to bolster liquidity and strengthen its competitive position, according to CEO Mat Ishbia. The move sparked a sharp market reaction as investors reassess the company's financial strategy.

news.headline: Airbnb stock soars 9% on earnings and revenue beat, strong guidance for third quarter
news.summary: Airbnb delivered a blowout quarter with revenue and earnings topping expectations, fueled by robust demand across all regions. The beat powered strong forward guidance for Q3, sending shares up 9% and signaling the travel-booking giant's momentum remains intact.

educational.title: The Emergency Fund Rule Nobody Follows (But Should)
points: An emergency fund is 3-6 months of essential expenses, kept in cash, not invested
It's not for vacations — it's for job loss, medical bills, or a broken car
Without one, a single bad month can force you into high-interest debt
Keep it boring: a high-yield savings account, not the stock market
Build it before investing aggressively — it's the foundation everything else sits on
